name: Danube Cycle Path – Passau to Vienna
distance_note: about 320–333 km depending on the variant
summary: One of Europe's most popular cycle routes: downstream along the Danube through the Upper Danube valley, Linz and the Wachau to Vienna.
facts: Runs about 320–333 km from Passau to Vienna.
Mostly downhill with the river: from around 300 m above sea level in Passau to 158 m in Vienna.
The Wachau between Melk and Krems is widely seen as the most beautiful part.
notes: A great first multi-day trip: the challenge is not the terrain but pacing and accommodation.
Headwind along the river is the main thing that slows you down – compare the two scenarios below.
Many people ride it in 6–7 days with sightseeing; at a bikepacking pace it is much shorter.
days_hint: 6–7 days on the classic sightseeing itinerary
